aligned_chart_certificate.Eq120_effect: all three exterior rows vanish identically on g2=g3=g4=0

cover_decomposition.complete_set_theoretic_argument: either some g_k is nonzero, or every g_k is zero; in the latter case either f is nonzero (aligned obligation) or f=0 (delta_Q=0)
cover_decomposition.overlap_note: D(g2), D(g3), and D(g4) may overlap; this is a cover, not a partition

general_sufficient_conditions: directly exhibit all three target coordinate rows in Row(T_L)
or exhibit a localized-unit 5x5 minor, which is stronger than needed
or give local identities plus a certified unit-ideal/Bezout cover
exact_localized_obligation.pointwise_necessary_and_sufficient_condi: over every residue field of S_L, adjoining e_w2,e_w3,e_w4 does not increase the aligned restriction-matrix rank

pure_quotient_minor_sufficient_condition.required_unit_test: the quotient minor is a unit in S_L

exact_localized_obligation.rank_form_over_each_residue_field: rank(T_L)=rank(T_L with e_w2,e_w3,e_w4 adjoined); this pointwise test is not by itself a global module certificate
exact_localized_obligation.strong_global_sufficient_condition: e_w2,e_w3,e_w4 all belong to the row module of the five-column aligned restriction matrix over S_L; this is sufficient and functorial, but stronger than the residue-field rank condition

star_commutators.unit_equivalence: on D(f), commutativity is equivalent to w2=w3=w4=0

claim_boundary: this exact successor derives the fail-closed pointwise rank conditions and stronger accepted row-module certificate contracts on the three Eq120 ratio opens and the aligned remainder after the global 127-column unit elimination; it certifies no repair row, no localized repair minor, no unit-ideal cover, no global star membership, no noncommutative witness and no SR2-V terminal

Q5_fail_closed_audit.conclusion: a unit AB minor does not isolate w when either selected row has a Q5 coefficient; require C=0 or a genuine three-column module identity

Q5_free_pair_sufficient_condition.required_unit_test: D_rs is a unit in S_k

exact_localized_obligation.covered_minor_family_condition: for an ideal I of valid repair minors, require I*S_k=S_k; equivalently certify a Bezout identity after localization, or (I:g_k^infinity)=R after the declared base units are inverted
exact_localized_obligation.direct_certificate: exhibit coefficients p_r in S_k with sum p_r*(A_r,B_r,C_r)=e_w
exact_localized_obligation.pointwise_necessary_and_sufficient_condi: for every residue field kappa(p) of S_k, rank(T_k tensor kappa(p)) equals the rank after adjoining e_w=(0,1,0); equivalently every residue-field Schur-kernel vector has w=0
exact_localized_obligation.restriction_matrix: T_k has rows (A_r,B_r,C_r) for all Schur(M0) rows
exact_localized_obligation.ring_on_Uk: S_k=R[g_k^-1] with every declared base unit already inverted
exact_localized_obligation.strong_global_sufficient_condition: e_w=(0,1,0) belongs to Row_{S_k}(T_k); this gives a functorial localized identity and implies the pointwise condition, but is not necessary for residue-field or S_k-valued kernel vectors to have w=0

three_row_sufficient_condition.required_unit_test: the 3x3 determinant is a unit in S_k

gcd_fail_closed_audit.conclusion: multivariate gcd 1 is not a unit-ideal or cover certificate

generic_Schur_row_restriction.A: b1*r1*rho1 - b1*rho1 + b2*r2*rho2 - b2*rho2 + b3*r3*rho3 - b3*rho3 + b4*r4*rho4 - b4*rho4

row_module_strength_audit.conclusion: row-module membership is a strong scheme-theoretic/functorial certificate, not a necessary consequence of pointwise commutativity
row_module_strength_audit.nonmembership_reason: a*(-d,1,0)+b*(0,d,0)=e_w forces a*d=0, hence a=0 in the domain S, and then b*d=1 although d=u-1 is not a unit

three_non_aligned_charts.unit_equivalence: on D(g2), b2 and g2 are units, so c12=0 iff w=0
on D(g3), b3 and g3 are units, so c13=0 iff w=0
on D(g4), b4 and g4 are units, so c14=0 iff w=0

visible_reference_invariance.conclusion: changing the visible-vector reference rescales B and every AB pair minor by a declared diagonal unit; Q2/Q3/Q4 relabeling creates no new repair divisor or global non-aligned region, although it can refine the cover by opens such as D(r_i-r_j)

repair_certificate_contract.U2: prove the residue-field rank condition; a strong accepted route is e_w in Row(T_2) over R[g2^-1]
repair_certificate_contract.U3: prove the residue-field rank condition; a strong accepted route is e_w in Row(T_3) over R[g3^-1]
repair_certificate_contract.U4: prove the residue-field rank condition; a strong accepted route is e_w in Row(T_4) over R[g4^-1]
accepted_global_proof_forms: direct localized row-module identities with only declared-unit denominators
localized-unit minors whose hypotheses include the Q5 column
a finite chart family with an exact saturation/unit-ideal or Bezout cover
repair_certificate_contract.aligned: prove the three residue-field rank conditions; a strong accepted route is e_w2,e_w3,e_w4 in Row(T_L) over (R/(g2,g3,g4))[f^-1]
rejected_promotions: finite rational or finite-field rank agreement
a minor nonzero at one or finitely many points
multivariate gcd equal to one without a unit-ideal certificate
an AB minor that ignores nonzero Q5 coefficients
calling row-module membership necessary merely because every residue-field kernel has w=0
